name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $89 on 19 Nov, 21% lower over a month; Hormuz attacks continue but no new outage confirmed
state: Brent was near $89.3 early on 19 Nov, 6.8% lower on the week and 21% lower over a month, inside the $85–110 Watch band and 25% below its 52-week high of $118 (Yahoo Finance). Attacks on shipping around Hormuz continued, including an ADNOC vessel hit on 17 Nov (The National). No new outage above 2 mb/d was confirmed.
for_you: Fuel prices tend to follow crude with a lag of a few weeks; the recent fall may ease pump prices if it holds.

sources.title: The National — Iran attacks Kuwait in widening escalation

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
